name: Community — Krea 2 Identity Edit
author: lbouaraba / conradlocke
description: Image editing on Krea 2: hand it a photo and an instruction in plain English. Two presets on one LoRA - Identity Edit at neutral fidelity for outfit, colour and lighting changes, and Identity Lock at fidelity 4.0 for holding a face while you re-stage a character sheet into a new scene, transfer a face between two images, or do virtual try-on. Shares the Krea 2 turbo checkpoint, Qwen3-VL encoder and Qwen-Image VAE with our Krea 2 pack, so the only new download is a 1.83 GB LoRA. Masked inpainting is not included - SimpliGen presets cannot pass a mask.

presets.name: Krea 2 Identity Edit
presets.tagline: Change one thing, keep the rest
presets.description: Edits the image you supply while leaving everything else alone - swap an outfit, change a colour, relight the scene. Reference fidelity sits at 1.0, the neutral setting, so the model follows your instruction without pulling the result back toward the reference. Supply a second image to bring a person or an object in from elsewhere: image 1 is the scene, image 2 is the subject, and that order is what the model was trained on.

requirements.notes: Krea 2 turbo DiT + Qwen3-VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE, all shared with our Krea 2 pack, plus a 1.83 GB identity-edit LoRA in models/loras/. Needs the comfyui-krea2edit custom node (Apache-2.0, pinned); SimpliGen installs it with the pack. Ten steps at CFG 1, euler/simple. REFERENCE ORDER MATTERS: image 1 is the scene being edited, image 2 is the subject being brought in - the LoRA was trained scene-first, and swapping them degrades the result without raising an error. NO MASKING: SimpliGen presets cannot pass a mask, so the tutorial's inpainting and outpainting sections are not reproduced here; the node's own ref_boost_mask is left unconnected. The tutorial also suggests replacing the VAE with 'Krea 2 Real VAE' (artsyww/KREA2REALVAE) for skin texture. That file carries no licence at all and community comparisons report only a marginal difference, so this pack ships Comfy-Org's qwen_image_vae; swap it yourself if you want it. Smaller LoRA ranks exist in the same repo (r128 914 MB, r64 457 MB) if 1.83 GB is too much.

presets.name: Krea 2 Identity Lock
presets.tagline: Hold the face; restage from a character sheet
presets.description: The same editor with reference fidelity turned up to 4.0, which is what holds a face. Use it to re-stage a character sheet into a new scene ("re-stage this woman on a rainy street at night"), to put the face from image 2 onto the person in image 1, or for virtual try-on. Image 1 is the scene, image 2 is the subject. If a result comes back over-baked or plasticky, use the Identity Edit preset instead - that is the same graph at fidelity 1.0.
